ward.summary: In Bandra West, Khar West and Santacruz West (ward H/W), ₹42.5 lakh of the ₹43.0 lakh budget was spent, which is 99% and within budget, across 62 jobs. Repairs redone within 30 days came to 26%, against 24% expected, so durability is in line with expectations; the money spent on repairs that failed was ₹13.9 lakh. Two jobs are listed for billing review. Nine open issues would cost ₹3.4 lakh to fix, but only ₹0.5 lakh remains, enough for 3 of them. Top priorities are the Linking Road manhole cover (₹0.5 lakh), a Linking Road pothole (₹0.2 lakh) and SV Road drain desilting (₹0.7 lakh). The remaining budget does not cover all of them.
